source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 2 · lesson 6. Exercises reused from the lesson.
topic: Wahi, the five books, and the protected Qur'an

learn.en: Allah sent guidance to His prophets. This guidance is called wahi — revelation. Angel Jibreel brought it to them.
learn.title: Wahi: revelation

learn.en: The Suhuf were given to Ibraheem, the Zaboor to Dawood, the Tawrah to Musa, the Injeel to Isa, and the Qur'an to Muhammad ﷺ.
learn.title: Five books

learn.en: All these books had the same message: Lā ilāha illa-llāh — there is no god but Allah.
learn.title: One message

learn.en: Except for the Qur'an, the other books were lost or changed by people — but we believe Allah once sent them.
learn.title: Lost or changed

learn.en: Allah has protected the Qur'an exactly as it came to our Prophet ﷺ. “Indeed, it is We who sent down the message, and indeed, We will be its guardian.” (Qur'an 15:9)
learn.title: The Qur'an is protected

order.en: Put the books in the order they were sent

quiz.en: The Tawrah was given to Prophet…
The Injeel was given to Prophet…
The Zaboor was given to Prophet…
The Suhuf were given to Prophet…
Which book has Allah protected in its original form?

think.q: Why is it special that the Qur'an has never changed, not even one letter?
think.a: Because Allah protects it — we read exactly the words Jibreel brought to the Prophet ﷺ.

parents.summary: Wahi (revelation) came through Jibreel; five books — Suhuf, Zaboor, Tawrah, Injeel, Qur'an — all teaching lā ilāha illa-llāh; only the Qur'an is preserved.
parents.tip: Make 5 cards (book + prophet) and play a matching game.
